title: Care aftercare packet - confirmed unit profiles (v1)
description: The inpatient units whose own phone number someone on the unit confirmed. A loaded profile is the only source of a CONFIRMED unit phone, which a Final copy needs (it names the unit and promises a call to the unit's number). Shape only: validate_care_inserts.py (check_profiles) enforces what a schema cannot: unique ids; a ten-digit North American unitPhone a patient can dial (area code and exchange start 2-9, neither a service code such as 411) that is not a registered crisis number and not a helpline-table number; phoneConfirmedOn a real past date (a warning when stale); phoneConfirmedBy a role with no digits or email; label, org and unitName free of markup, braces, control characters, phone numbers, crisis numbers, dose literals, verification wording, availability promises and the phrases the resident build rewrites; and brandingApproved only with an org. The build ships id, label, org (only when brandingApproved is true; otherwise null), brandingApproved, unitName, unitPhone and callbackProgram, plus usableThrough (phoneConfirmedOn plus 180 days); the confirmation record (phoneConfirmedOn, phoneConfirmedBy) is never shipped. The build checks every date against the generatedAt of care-inserts.v1.json (the build reads no clock), so a profile confirmed after that date needs generatedAt raised in the same change; the date must be the real one, never back-dated. Profiles apply to both learner sites. Never a patient's details.

profiles.description: Empty until the owner adds a profile whose phone was confirmed. The trainee loads one explicitly; nothing is loaded by default.

label.description: What the trainee picks in the profile list. Not printed.

org.description: The organization or site line. Printed only when brandingApproved is true; null for none.

brandingApproved.description: True only once institutional branding approval for org is recorded. Requires a non-null org.

callbackProgram.description: True only when the unit runs a call-back program; the callback page needs it in a Final copy.

phoneConfirmedOn.description: The date someone on the unit confirmed unitPhone. Internal: never shipped.

phoneConfirmedBy.description: The ROLE that confirmed it (for example 'unit charge nurse'), never a person's name, number or email. Internal: never shipped.
